types.SM.IntervalComposition.expandComposition:
SM.IntervalComposition.expandComposition_weight.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) {J : SM.BoundaryInterval t.contractedSize} (π : SM.IntervalComposition J)
  (D H : SM.TripleArray n R) :

SM.nearFarTransform_expanded_off_leaf.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (D H : SM.TripleArray n R) (X : SM.IntervalArray n R)
  (J : SM.BoundaryInterval t.contractedSize)
  (hJ : ¬(J.left ≤ t.contractedLeaf.left ∧ t.contractedLeaf.right ≤ J.right)) :
  SM.nearFarTransform (SM.contractedTripleArray t D) (SM.contractedTripleArray t H) (fun I => X (t.expandInterval I))
      J =
    SM.nearFarTransform D H X (t.expandInterval J)

SM.geometricBoundaryArray_contractedWord.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]

types.SM.contracted_output_tree:
SM.contracted_output_tree.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n)
  (g : ZMod n) (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
  (hZ : SM.pointZeroTriples P = {SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple.vertexSet g t})
  (hproper : t.spanInterval ≠ SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn) :
  SM.farOnlyOutput (SM.contractedTripleArray t (SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g)) (SM.fullBoundaryInterval ⋯) =
    ↑(SM.treeCoefficient (SM.contractedWordTuple P g t) ⋯ 0 ⋯)
types.SM.IntervalComposition.unique_contracted:
SM.IntervalComposition.unique_contracted_leaf_child {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n)
  {J : SM.BoundaryInterval t.contractedSize} (π : SM.IntervalComposition J)
  (hJ : J.left ≤ t.contractedLeaf.left ∧ t.contractedLeaf.right ≤ J.right) :
  ∃! k, (π.part k).left ≤ t.contractedLeaf.left ∧ t.contractedLeaf.right ≤ (π.part k).right
types.SM.expanded_child_product_response:
SM.expanded_child_product_response.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (hH : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) {J : SM.BoundaryInterval t.contractedSize}
  (π : SM.IntervalComposition J) (hJ : J.left ≤ t.contractedLeaf.left ∧ t.contractedLeaf.right ≤ J.right) (s : R)
  (hchild :
    ∀ (k : Fin π.parts),
      (π.part k).left ≤ t.contractedLeaf.left →
        t.contractedLeaf.right ≤ (π.part k).right →
          SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₂ (t.expandInterval (π.part k)) -
              SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ (t.expandInterval (π.part k)) =
            s * SM.farOnlyCoordinates (SM.contractedTripleArray t H₁) (π.part k)) :
  ∏ k, SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₂ (t.expandInterval (π.part k)) -
      ∏ k, SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ (t.expandInterval (π.part k)) =
    s * ∏ k, SM.farOnlyCoordinates (SM.contractedTripleArray t H₁) (π.part k)
types.SM.nonsurviving_child_product_unchanged:
SM.nonsurviving_child_product_unchanged.{u_1} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (t : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n) (H₁ H₂ : SM.TripleArray n R)
  (hH : ∀ (u : SM.IncreasingBoundaryTriple n), u ≠ t → H₁ u = H₂ u) {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n}
  (π : SM.IntervalComposition I) (hπ : ¬SM.IntervalComposition.SurvivingCuts t π) :
  ∏ k, SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₁ (π.part k) = ∏ k, SM.farOnlyCoordinates H₂ (π.part k)
